title: Triangles, circles, polygons: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 6 questions, 12 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: A triangle has sides 13 cm, 14 cm and 15 cm. What is its area, in cm²?
In triangle ABC, AB = 6, AC = 9 and BC = 10. The bisector of angle A meets BC at D. What is BD?
A, B and C lie on a circle with centre O, and C is on the major arc AB. If angle AOB = 110°, what is angle ACB in degrees?
The tangent from a point P to a circle of radius 7 cm is 24 cm long. How far is P from the centre?
A regular hexagon has side 4 cm. Its area is k√3 cm². What is k?
Two similar triangles have areas 36 cm² and 81 cm². A side of the smaller one is 8 cm. What is the matching side of the larger one?
